raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- With `--dcp-size > 1`, the aiter MLA DCP decode defaults to the asm kernel (`SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND=asm`). It is a8w8: it casts Q to fp8 and passes the KV cache's fp8 scale.
- A bf16 KV cache, the default, has no scale. aiter raises `fp8 Q requires q_scale and kv_scale`, and the server fails during CUDA graph capture.
- So any MLA model with DCP and the default KV dtype cannot start on aiter.

## Modifications

- The asm DCP decode now also requires an fp8 KV cache (`_mla_dcp_asm_selected`). Other caches use the existing Gluon DCP decode; fp8 caches are unchanged.
- When `asm` was requested but the cache rules it out, the backend logs it once.
- `mla_gluon_supports_dcp_decode` (in `aiter_mla_gluon.py`) checks what aiter's `mla_gluon` asserts at run time. If the DCP decode falls to Gluon and Gluon cannot run it, startup fails with a clear `ValueError` instead of crashing at the first decode. The check runs only when this backend runs MLA decode.

| KV cache | `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND` | DCP decode kernel |
|---|---|---|
| fp8 | `asm` (default) | asm (unchanged) |
| fp8 | `gluon` | Gluon (unchanged) |
| bf16 | `asm` (default) | Gluon (was: crash) |
| bf16 | `gluon` | Gluon (unchanged) |

| Gluon requirement (else startup `ValueError`) | Source |
|---|---|
| Gluon importable, Triton >= 3.7, `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_GLUON=1` | `_gluon_fn` probe |
| gfx950 | `mla_gluon` arch assert |
| 1-96 gathered heads, not 64 | bh16 regimes; bh64 (64/128 heads) needs batch % 64 == 0 |
| bf16 or fp8 e4m3fn KV | bh16 KV dtype assert |

- Tests: `TestMlaDcpDecodeRoute` pins the route (its bf16 case fails before the fix); `TestMlaGluonSupportsDcpDecode` pins the Gluon limits.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, TP2, aiter, MI355X. GSM8K: sgl-eval 0.1.3, 200 questions, greedy, max_tokens 1024.

| Setup | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| bf16 KV, DCP2 | fails at startup | 0.550 |
| bf16 KV, DCP1 (reference) | 0.535 | unchanged |

- The scores count `\boxed{}` answers only. This model often writes "The answer is: N", which they miss; lenient scoring gives 0.67-0.71.
- End to end on our ROCm tree with this commit applied. The unit tests run on main.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- None: bf16 KV with DCP did not start before.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No user-facing change.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

`pytest test/registered/attention/test_aiter_gluon_h12_fp8.py`: 29 passed. pre-commit passes.

@@ -89,6 +89,7 @@
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.aiter_mla_gluon import (
     log_mla_gluon_capability,
     mla_gluon_decode,
+    mla_gluon_supports_dcp_decode,
     prefer_mla_gluon_decode,
 )
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.aiter_utils import (
@@ -140,6 +141,22 @@ def _asm_cprr_kernel_heads(gathered_heads: int, q_len: int) -> int:
     return 0
 
 
+def _mla_dcp_asm_selected(
+    *, use_mla: bool, dcp_world_size: int, decode_backend: str, kv_cache_dtype
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether DCP decode runs on aiter's asm MLA kernel.
+
+    That kernel is a8w8: it casts the query to fp8 and reads the KV cache with its
+    fp8 scale. Any other cache decodes on Gluon.
+    """
+    return (
+        use_mla
+        and dcp_world_size > 1
+        and decode_backend == "asm"
+        and kv_cache_dtype == fp8_dtype
+    )
+
+
 # (v_head_dim -> query head counts) that aiter's mla_reduce_v1 has an
 # instantiation. This map is copied from MLA_REDUCE_ROUTER in
 # aiter/csrc/kernels/mla/reduce.cu. See https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/blob/7915f53a4225b3f9cb632a97a23369dbebcf1be0/csrc/kernels/mla/reduce.cu#L923
@@ -427,10 +444,11 @@ def __init__(
                 "SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND must be 'gluon' or 'asm', "
                 f"got {self.mla_decode_backend!r}"
             )
-        self.use_mla_dcp_asm = (
-            self.use_mla
-            and self.dcp_world_size > 1
-            and self.mla_decode_backend == "asm"
+        self.use_mla_dcp_asm = _mla_dcp_asm_selected(
+            use_mla=self.use_mla,
+            dcp_world_size=self.dcp_world_size,
+            decode_backend=self.mla_decode_backend,
+            kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
         )
         self.mla_verify_backend = envs.SGLANG_AITER_MLA_VERIFY_BACKEND.get().lower()
         if self.mla_verify_backend not in ("gluon", "asm"):
@@ -654,6 +672,12 @@ def __init__(
             self.mla_kernel_num_head_padded = (
                 16 if _gathered_num_head < 16 else _gathered_num_head
             )
+            if (
+                self.dcp_world_size > 1
+                and not self.use_mla_dcp_asm
+                and may_run_mla_decode
+            ):
+                self._check_mla_dcp_gluon_decode(gathered_num_head=_gathered_num_head)
 
             self.attn_dp_enabled = is_dp_attention_enabled()
             self.qo_indptr_ = torch.zeros(
@@ -748,6 +772,26 @@ def check_fp8_prefill_num_head(
         larger = [h for h in supported if h > num_head]
         return min(larger) if larger else None
 
+    def _check_mla_dcp_gluon_decode(self, *, gathered_num_head: int) -> None:
+        """Fail at startup when the DCP decode falls to Gluon and Gluon cannot run it."""
+        if self.mla_decode_backend == "asm":
+            logger.info(
+                "aiter MLA DCP decode runs on Gluon: the asm kernel needs an "
+                "fp8 KV cache, and this one is %s.",
+                self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            )
+        if not mla_gluon_supports_dcp_decode(
+            gathered_num_head=gathered_num_head, kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"aiter MLA DCP decode runs on Gluon here ({gathered_num_head} "
+                f"gathered heads, {self.kv_cache_dtype} KV cache), and Gluon cannot "
+                "run it: it needs gfx950, Triton >= 3.7, SGLANG_AITER_MLA_GLUON=1, "
+                "at most 96 gathered heads other than 64, and a bf16 or fp8 e4m3fn "
+                "KV cache (see the 'aiter mla gluon' log). Otherwise use "
+                "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 with SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND=asm."
+            )
+
     def may_run_mla_decode_kernel(
         self,
         *,

@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@
 
 from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import fp8_dtype
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
     from sglang.srt.layers.radix_attention import RadixAttention
@@ -60,6 +61,23 @@ def log_mla_gluon_capability(log: logging.Logger | None = None) -> None:
     )
 
 
+def mla_gluon_supports_dcp_decode(
+    *, gathered_num_head: int, kv_cache_dtype: torch.dtype
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether aiter's Gluon MLA can run a DCP decode of this shape here.
+
+    mla_gluon asserts gfx950, and decodes only in its bh16 regimes: at most 96
+    heads but not 64, over a bf16 or e4m3fn cache. Its bh64 regime needs batch % 64.
+    """
+    return (
+        _gluon_fn() is not None
+        and is_gfx95_supported()
+        and 1 <= gathered_num_head <= 96
+        and gathered_num_head != 64
+        and kv_cache_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    )
+
+
 def prefer_mla_gluon_decode(
     *, head_pad_mode: str, num_head: int, kv_cache_dtype: torch.dtype
 ) -> bool:

@@ -445,5 +445,70 @@ def test_default_gluon_dcp_skips_persist_like_main(self):
         self.assertFalse(be._use_mla_decode_persist_metadata())
 
 
+class TestMlaDcpDecodeRoute(CustomTestCase):
+    """The asm DCP decode casts the gathered query to fp8 and passes the KV cache's
+    fp8 scale. Over a bf16 cache there is no scale, aiter rejected the call ("fp8 Q
+    requires q_scale and kv_scale"), and a DCP server with the default KV dtype
+    failed at startup. Such caches decode on Gluon."""
+
+    def _selected(self, **overrides):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.aiter_backend import _mla_dcp_asm_selected
+
+        kwargs = dict(
+            use_mla=True,
+            dcp_world_size=2,
+            decode_backend="asm",
+            kv_cache_dtype=fp8_dtype,
+        )
+        kwargs.update(overrides)
+        return _mla_dcp_asm_selected(**kwargs)
+
+    def test_fp8_cache_takes_the_asm_decode(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._selected())
+
+    def test_bf16_cache_decodes_on_gluon(self):
+        self.assertFalse(self._selected(kv_cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+
+    def test_dcp1_and_the_gluon_backend_skip_the_asm_decode(self):
+        self.assertFalse(self._selected(dcp_world_size=1))
+        self.assertFalse(self._selected(decode_backend="gluon"))
+
+
+class TestMlaGluonSupportsDcpDecode(CustomTestCase):
+    """mla_gluon asserts gfx950, runs decode only in its bh16 regimes (<= 96 heads,
+    not 64, bf16 or e4m3fn KV), and its bh64 regime (64, 128 heads) needs batch % 64.
+    A DCP decode routed to Gluon outside these must fail at startup, not at decode."""
+
+    def _supports(self, *, gfx950=True, **overrides):
+        kwargs = dict(gathered_num_head=96, kv_cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        kwargs.update(overrides)
+        with (
+            mock.patch(_GLUON_FN, return_value=mock.Mock()),
+            mock.patch.object(mod, "is_gfx95_supported", return_value=gfx950),
+        ):
+            return mod.mla_gluon_supports_dcp_decode(**kwargs)
+
+    def test_bh16_shapes_on_gfx950(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._supports())
+        self.assertTrue(self._supports(kv_cache_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn))
+        self.assertTrue(self._supports(gathered_num_head=48))
+
+    def test_bh64_and_oversized_head_counts(self):
+        for heads in (64, 97, 128):
+            self.assertFalse(self._supports(gathered_num_head=heads))
+
+    def test_other_arch_and_kv_dtype(self):
+        self.assertFalse(self._supports(gfx950=False))
+        self.assertFalse(self._supports(kv_cache_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fnuz))
+
+    def test_unavailable_gluon(self):
+        with mock.patch(_GLUON_FN, return_value=None):
+            self.assertFalse(
+                mod.mla_gluon_supports_dcp_decode(
+                    gathered_num_head=96, kv_cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+            )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
